text:
Good evening service crew,
Thanks for a bustling fortnight; the lead dispatcher mentioned a point about handover notes

I am writing from the Companion Animal Travel Desk because several recent cases show that passengers are still being moved between teams without a clear, calm handover. That is creating avoidable stress for owners, and it also leaves pets waiting while details are checked again. Please treat each note as part of the care plan, not just a filing step. When a passenger arrives worried, listen carefully, confirm what has already been accepted, and pass along any concern without delay so the next colleague can act with confidence.

For bird bookings, <<FACT F065>> Please place that detail exactly where it belongs in the file and make sure no one has to search for it later. For reptile arrangements, <<FACT F060>> That needs to be visible to the team before acceptance is confirmed, because a late surprise only increases the chance of a frustrated call and a missed check. If any case looks uncertain, escalate it at once rather than leaving the passenger to chase updates. We owe them a steady response, and Aurelia Skyways should feel like one coordinated service from first contact to arrival.

I am asking everyone to tighten the handover routine from this point onward. Clear notes, prompt flags, and a respectful tone will protect the traveler, the pet, and the desk. Thank you for stepping in quickly whenever a file needs attention, and for treating every journey as a shared responsibility.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
